editorial:
Imagine meeting someone when you are just a kid, feeling that first spark, and then losing touch for years. That is exactly what happens here. You follow two young people who bond during their teenage years but get pulled apart by life. When they finally meet again as adults, they are completely different people. One has grown hard, and the other has changed in ways they never expected. It feels like a warm, cozy blanket of a movie that asks if first love can ever really die, even when you do not recognize the person standing in front of you anymore.

The acting is what really sells the story, as you can feel the tension and the longing in every scene. While the pacing is a bit slow at times, it helps you feel the passage of years. If you love stories about fate and second chances, you need to see this.
endingExplained: At the end, the two main characters finally stop fighting their feelings and the changes in their personalities. They realize that while they are not the same kids they used to be, the core of their love never left. They decide to stop running from their past and commit to a future together. The movie wraps up with a sweet scene showing them finally at peace, proving that true love lasts through any change.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about first love and second chances.
